resource: Text of one chat intent or line
allocation_impact: The decoder refuses text above 1,020 bytes before copying it; an intent is at most 1,148 bytes (command type 13) and a line at most 1,194 bytes (domain 12 delta type 1).
boundary_tests: max=1020: a say intent and a local line with 1,020 bytes of text round-trip at their byte bounds
max+1=1021: 1,021 bytes of text are refused in both directions
notes: CHAT-0 §4 and §8. The character bound of the same row is CHAT0-RL-01A. Registered by OTV2-20261001-chat-1b-1.
